compliance_tests.scope: Verify audit-log retention enforces the Computer Crime Act 90-day minimum retention window (rows >= 90 days old retained; deletion before 90d blocked). Retention threshold sourced from CCA-TH-LOG-90D citation, not invented (AP-Q9).
Verify audit-log rows carry tamper-evident hashing (e.g. hash-chained per row) and any in-place modification is detectable. Append-only invariant per OQ-20.
Verify every read of the audit-log surface itself is audit-emitted (access audit per 6.6). Reader identity and queried filter captured.

Verify procedure for lawful-access requests (law-enforcement / regulator). Audit-log export workflow exists, is admin-gated, is itself audit-emitted, and uses the scrubbing path that fails-closed on forbidden-field detection.
Verify final price displayed pre-submit includes VAT + shipping per Consumer Protection Act truthful-pricing rule; no hidden surcharges added post-confirm.
Consumer Protection Act: refund-timeline disclosure on cancellation (manual OOB) - customer-facing copy and notification must state expected refund window; OOB workflow documented.
Verify order/audit payloads reference customer_id only and do not duplicate raw PII (full address, phone) beyond the order_line snapshot scope; PDPA minimization principle.

Customer submits a Data Subject Access Request and receives a structured export of their EPIC-IDENTITY data (email, name, phone, addresses, customer_id, audit-event summary). Test asserts response within statutory window and excludes password hash from the export payload.

Customer submits a rectification request for name / phone / shipping_address; system updates the canonical row, emits banking_grade_audit event with before/after, and propagates correction to active-order snapshots per documented policy.

Customer submits a right-to-erasure request. Test asserts: (a) erasure executes on rows whose retention window has expired, (b) rows retained for accounting (e.g., order-attached address snapshots under Thai Revenue Code 5y retention) remain with documented legal basis, (c) erasure audit event emitted.

Simulate a detected PII breach affecting EPIC-IDENTITY data. Test asserts the documented incident-response runbook fires a notification to the PDPC and affected data subjects within 72 hours, and that the breach-notification message contains the statutory required fields without tipping-off vocabulary.

Signup UI presents per-purpose consent toggles (account creation, marketing communications, analytics) at granularity required by PDPA. Test asserts (a) each toggle records lawful basis separately, (b) account creation cannot be conditioned on marketing consent, (c) withdrawing consent is as easy as granting.

Verify PII-redaction rule applied to all log surfaces per pii_inventory[*].masking_rule. Sample-based scan across audit log and notification log; zero leaks for always-masked fields (password, session_token); partial-mask pattern verified for phone/email in non-fulfilment surfaces; address scrubbed from authz_denied payloads.

Verify cross-border-transfer controls when mock-shipping or mock-payment endpoints route through non-Thailand regions. Residency-rule per pii_inventory enforced; transfer events audit-emitted with destination region recorded.

Verify each processing activity (signup, order, review-submit, audit-read, notification-send, review-moderation) is annotated with a lawful basis (consent / contract / legitimate-interest / legal-obligation) and that the record-of-processing-activities export contains all activities.
Verify VAT line-item (7%) is displayed on receipts and order confirmation per Thai Revenue Code requirements for retail e-commerce.
Thai Revenue Code: 5-year accounting record retention for order, payment, audit-log artefacts; verify retention policy on audit rows for order state transitions and admin-cancel reasons.

strategy.mock_vs_real_strategy: Mock payment provider (mock-PSP) and mock shipping provider for v1.0.0 per BA scope. Real postgres + redis in CI ephemeral env. Contract tests carry the contract-shape to a future real PSP. Race-condition tests require deterministic concurrency primitive with clock control + lock instrumentation.
strategy.tier_rationale: T2 baseline across all 5 epics per BA initiative.per_epic_tier (all epics tagged T2). Customer-facing PII surfaces and monetary state changes justify T2 pyramid weighting. Integration tests carry the bulk of banking-grade coverage (idempotency replay, audit emission, authz cross-tenant) since unit tests cannot validate cross-component contracts.

test_data_specs.synthesis_rules: Surrogate customer_id format CUST-{8-hex-digits-from-seed}. Used in audit events as the only PII-adjacent identifier (per PII inventory rule that customer_id is the audit surrogate).
Second surrogate customer_id for cross-customer authz scenarios. Distinct deterministic 8-hex suffix from the same frozen seed.

Synthetic email pattern: customer+{seq}@shoppilot.test where {seq} is a zero-padded 6-digit counter from a frozen seed. Domain shoppilot.test guarantees non-routable. Never reuse real customer emails (AP-Q7). Bilingual signup glossary preserved for any display-side rendering.
Synthetic non-existent email pattern: unknown+{seq}@shoppilot.test guaranteed to not exist in customer table. Used to probe unknown-email branch of login without leaking real PII.

Bilingual name fixtures drawn from BA glossary: Thai surface form 'นิรันดร์' / Latin transliteration 'Niran' preserved together. Counter suffix appended for uniqueness ('Niran-{seq}'). Both surface forms travel through display, audit-scrub, and DB layers.

Order-number format ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN with date pinned to the fixture time anchor (2026-05-12) and NNNNNN drawn from the frozen sequence. Suffix predictability concern parked under OQ-05 (handled by EPIC-CART-CHECKOUT). Used here only to wire the address-referenced-by-active-order scenario.

Password fixtures stored as pre-computed one-way hash references (e.g., FIX-IDENTITY-pw-hash-A, FIX-IDENTITY-pw-hash-B); plaintext is generated ephemerally inside the test process only and is NEVER persisted to fixture files, logs, or screenshots. Plaintext is also never echoed in assertion messages. (AP-Q7, AP-Q12.)
Pre-canned weak-password literals ('123', 'aaaa', '') held only in the security-test fixture, never in shared fixtures. Asserts the strength predicate rejects them. Exact predicate TBD pending OQ-03.
Thai mobile format 0812345{NNN} where {NNN} is a 3-digit counter from the frozen seed. Stays inside the reserved test prefix; no real Thai subscriber number reused (AP-Q7).

Synthetic review strings drawn from a fixed pool of bilingual user-generated content templates; intentionally contain NO real PII. Used to validate that review-text PII-leakage scenarios surface a moderation flag rather than leaking real data.

Opaque base64 token rendered from frozen seed: base64(sha256('FIX-IDENTITY-session_token::' || seq)) truncated to 32 bytes. Token value never appears in assertion text, never logged, never asserted-equal in plaintext — assertions check 'present' or 'cleared' only.

Thai postal address structure: street='Test Soi {seq}', subdistrict='Khlong Toei Nuea', district='Watthana', province='Bangkok', postcode='10110'. All values from a frozen non-routable test catalog of Bangkok postal codes; never a real customer's address (AP-Q7). Scrubbed from authz_denied audit payloads per PII inventory rule.
Second synthetic Thai postal address for default-swap scenarios. postcode='10330' (Pathum Wan). Same fabrication rules as FIX-IDENTITY-shipping_address.

Synthetic tracking-number pattern TRK-{12-alnum-from-seed}; not present on any real carrier. Referenced from IDENTITY fixtures only for cross-customer read-attempt negative tests (no positive use in EPIC-IDENTITY).
In-memory append-only audit sink with assert helpers for field-by-field event inspection and allow-list scans for forbidden fields (password, token, PAN, CVV).
Generate P1 with status=active, price=300 THB, stock_available=10; customer C1 with synthetic email animate90+c1@example.test (no real PII).
Customer C1 authenticated, cart empty, no prior orders.
Customer C1 with existing cart line P1 qty=2 and P1 stock_available=10.
Idempotency key 'ik-cart-001' replayed twice on add-to-cart request.
Product P1 with stock_available=5, status=active.
Product P1 starts active with cart line; admin action flips P1.status to paused at T0+30s. Frozen clock.
Cart configured so subtotal == 4000 exactly.
Cart configured so subtotal == 600 exactly (e.g. P1 price=300 qty=2).
Cart with subtotal == 80 to exercise discount clamp.
Customers C1 and C2 with separate carts and addresses; never share session.
Synthetic address owned by C1 with non-real phone and address strings; address_id='addr-c1-001'.
Synthetic address owned by C2; used to attempt cross-owner reference from C1.
100 sequential checkout submissions to inspect order_number generation distribution.
Customer C1 with valid cart of P1 qty=2, address A1 owned by C1, optional coupon WELCOME100.
Cart with EXPIRED50 coupon applied at preview; clock advanced past coupon expiry before submit.
Authenticated session for customer C1 with bearer token.
Five distinct synthetic customers C1..C5, each with P1 qty=1 in cart.
Product P1 with stock_available=1 to drive race-resolution test.
Product P1 stock_available=3.
Customers C1 and C2 with identical cart state {P1 qty=1}.
Programmatic clock-advance API used by sweep tests; supports advance(seconds) and reset().
Deterministic concurrency harness with controllable thread/coroutine scheduling and lock instrumentation; supports barrier-synced parallel submits.
Coupon 'EXPIRED50' with valid_until=T0-1h (already expired at submit).
Coupon code 'SAVE10', percent=10, cap=300, min-order=0.
Coupon code 'WELCOME100', fixed-THB=100, min-order=500, quota_remaining=1000, valid_from=T0-1d, valid_until=T0+30d.
Variant of WELCOME100 with min-order=50 to test clamp on subtotal=80.
Idempotency key 'ik-chk-001' derived from sha256(customer_id+cart_snapshot_hash+frozen_seed='SEED-2026-05-12'); reused across two submit calls.
Idempotency key 'ik-coup-001' derived from sha256(customer_id+coupon_code+frozen_seed='SEED-2026-05-12').
Order O1 with grand_total=560, status='awaiting-payment'.
Order O1 in status='awaiting-payment' with P1 stock_reserved=2.
Order with WELCOME100 coupon applied, then cancelled before payment to drive quota-reversal test.
Order O1 already transitioned to 'paid' via prior webhook for duplicate-callback test.
Replay of provider_event_id='evt-001' for webhook idempotency test.
Three sibling payloads covering success/failure/timeout for parameterized audit-event test.
Mock PSP webhook with outcome='failure', reason_code='declined'.
Mock PSP that never delivers callback; used with FX-CLOCK-control to drive timeout sweep.

Mock PSP webhook payload with outcome='success', amount matches order, provider_event_id='evt-001'. Synthetic credit-card payload (card_holder='TEST USER', card_last4='4242', no PAN/CVV captured by app per PCI-out-of-scope rule).
Mock PSP webhook with outcome='success' but amount=500 vs order grand_total=560.
Webhook call from a non-configured origin or with invalid signature header.
Static T0 anchor for non-time-dependent tests.
Two-anchor frozen clock; T+10min crosses reservation TTL (assumed; TBD pending OQ-CART-reservation-ttl).
Two-anchor frozen clock for short-window failure tests.
Frozen clock harness; T0 fixed; advance to T0+1h for expiry tests.

Admin actor records (role=admin, username='aoy' and a second admin for concurrency tests) used as audit-event actors only — no customer PII. Pre-existing product with SKU 'SKU-EL-001', price=1290, status=active, category=Electronics, stock=10 to support duplicate-SKU rejection, price-change audit, SKU-immutability, and idempotent-replay scenarios. Pre-issued idempotency_key 'ik-prod-001' bound to one prior successful edit. Reason-for-change free-text seed values for audit payload assertions.

20 seed products: 12 with status=active and stock_available>0 (10 in-stock + 2 will be toggled out-of-stock for the in-stock-only filter test), 8 with status in {draft, paused, deleted}. Distribute the 12 active products across 5 categories with Electronics having at least 3 SKUs. Include bilingual product names (Thai + English) sourced from the BA glossary surface forms. Each product carries: SKU (immutable), slug, name, description, image, price (>0), compare-at price (nullable), category_id, stock_available, status, public/hidden flag. Includes a soft-deleted product P3 reachable by deep link, an active product P1 (price=1290, stock=5, rating=4.2, review_count=11), and a paused product P2.
Catalog state where P1.price was 1290 at order time then mutated to 999. Used to verify snapshot immutability per 6.8.
Synthetic admin identity 'admin:aoy'; email pattern aoy+admin@example.test; no real PII (AP-Q7). Role=admin.
Synth corpus of mixed audit rows covering catalog/order/identity/payment/fulfillment events. Marker tokens injected for scrubbing assertions; never any real PII (AP-Q7).
Seeded audit row 'product.price_changed' with before={price:1290}, after={price:999}. No customer PII.

Synth corpus exercising one instance of each enumerated state-changing event class across all epics (catalog.*, order.*, inventory.adjusted, review.created, review.hidden, identity.*, payment.*, fulfillment.*).

Synthetic customer C1 with synth email c1@example.test, synth phone +66-XX-XXX-XXX0 (non-routable test range), name and Thai-format address generated from a closed test gazetteer; never use real customer data (AP-Q7).
Second synthetic customer used for authz negative tests; same synthesis rules as C1 (AP-Q7).
Synth corpus of customer-facing notifications: order-status updates, signup confirm, password reset, review-status. Synth recipients only (AP-Q7).
Synthetic order O1 delivered with one pre-existing review row for the P1 line (AP-Q7).
Synthetic order O1 in status='delivered' for C1, one line for P1. Address and order_number synthesized; tracking_number from synth carrier ID space (AP-Q7).
Synthetic order O1 in status='paid' (not delivered) for C1 (AP-Q7).
Synthetic review whose content is configured to trigger a specific moderation rule_id for tipping-off-copy tests (AP-Q7, AP-Q11).
Review row R1 with synth text in Thai; no incidental PII; tied to C1+O1+P1 (AP-Q7).
Catalog SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=5, stock_reserved=0, stock_sold=0. No PII.
SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=1, stock_reserved=0. No PII.
SKU P1 seeded with stock_available=2, stock_reserved=3 and 3 live reservations. No PII.

Marker-tokenized synthetic PII corpus driven through the system to produce realistic log volume. Markers are well-known sentinel strings ('SENTINEL_PWD', 'SENTINEL_TOKEN', etc.) so post-hoc log scans can deterministically count leaks. No real PII (AP-Q7).
Pre-seeded idempotency keys: ik-fulfil-001 (paid->packing), ik-cancel-001 (admin-cancel). Replay tests reuse exact keys to verify dedupe.

Frozen-state order fixtures at each state checkpoint: O-awaiting (awaiting_payment), O-paid (paid), O-packing (packing), O-shipped (shipped, tracking=TH123456789), O-delivered (delivered, terminal), O-cancelled (cancelled from paid). PII is synthetic-fake: deterministic seed=ecommerce-v5-fulfil; tipping-off scan clean. Order numbers conform to ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN with frozen date 2025-11-01.
Payment-captured marker rows for O-paid and O-cancelled orders, with no auto-refund record. Used by OOB-refund tests to assert compensating-action workflow.
Stock ledger snapshot: P1 stock_available=8, stock_sold=2 prior to cancel; expected post-cancel: stock_available=10, stock_sold=0. Idempotent fixture; resets per test run.

Deterministic synthetic Thailand-Post-format tracking numbers (TH + 9 digits). Seeded so TC-EPIC-ORDER-FULFILL-1-003/-005 always observe 'TH123456789'. Indirect identifier - flagged for tipping-off scan.
Role fixtures: admin:aoy (role=admin, tenant=T1), customer:C1 (role=customer, owns O1, tenant=T1), customer:C2 (role=customer, tenant=T1, no orders). Used for authz tests.
